title: Real2SAM2Real: Generative 3D Caches as Complementary Context for Video Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2606.00299v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) synthesize high-quality videos, but precise camera and motion control remains challenging when large viewpoint shifts, changing occlusions, or complex dynamics reveal unseen regions. Diffusion priors alone can yield structural inconsistencies, while warped guidance can contain incomplete geometry and misleading view-dependent appearance cues. Real2SAM2Real complements VDM priors with a coarse 3D foreground cache of topologically complete meshes for intuitive editing and animation. Generative 3D lifting estimates these object and human meshes, including unobserved surfaces, from a single reference image. Normal maps rendered under specified camera trajectories and foreground motions guide video synthesis in the VDM, while the reference image provides appearance conditioning. translated_title: Real2SAM2Real：生成式3D缓存作为视频扩散的补充上下文
translated_abstract: 视频扩散模型（VDM）能够合成高质量视频，但当大幅视角变化、动态遮挡变化或复杂动态揭示未见区域时，精确的相机和运动控制仍然充满挑战。仅依靠扩散先验可能导致结构性不一致，而基于扭曲的引导可能包含不完整的几何信息和具有误导性的视角相关外观线索。Real2SAM2Real 通过一个由拓扑完整网格组成的粗略3D前景缓存来补充VDM先验，实现直观的编辑与动画制作。生成式3D提升技术从单张参考图像中估计这些物体和人体网格，包括未被观测到的表面。在指定相机轨迹和前景运动下渲染的法线贴图引导VDM中的视频合成，同时参考图像提供外观条件约束。软性空间对齐注入和微创微调将这种引导融入模型，同时在很大程度上保留了预训练知识。
tldr: Real2SAM2Real 提出利用生成式3D提升技术构建拓扑完整的粗略3D前景缓存，通过法线贴图引导和微创微调实现视频扩散模型中精确的相机与运动控制。
en_tdlr: Real2SAM2Real leverages generative 3D lifting to build topologically complete coarse 3D foreground caches, using normal map guidance and minimally invasive fine-tuning to achieve precise camera and motion control in video diffusion models.
